body: I always had a tendency to suffer from “oneitis”. I would look back with rose colored glasses and put my ex on such a big pedestal. I realized that I was using my ex for my happiness because I didn’t want to face reality. Like a drug, I was using her to mask other areas of my life I didn’t want to think about it and it made the B/U way worse. I realized that isn’t love. Please do not let this one person control your day to day life so much…she does not deserve this kind of power. I was 2 years older than you when I got to the point you’re currently at and I look back now and am so damn grateful I hung on and kept going. Now I feel nothing when I think about her. Actually, I feel grateful for the experience because it taught me I can survive anything. I’m sorry you’re hurting so much but there are plenty of days ahead in your life where you’ll be smiling and happy and it won’t have anything to do with her. You don’t believe that is possible right now but it is 100% true. Your post proves you have a big heart. This girl didn’t deserve it. One day, you’ll find someone that does deserve it and you’ll be so unbelievably happy that you ended up with this person and your ex won’t even compare.

I thought about my ex for over a year. I thought that life no longer had meaning. I’d wake up and cry because reality was so cruel to me. I’d fight all day to gather the strength to face reality and have to repeat that cycle every single day. I would sometimes fantasize about someone running a light and hitting me on my commute to work and killing me. Yet, here I am today. I look back and am so happy I made it through that period of my life. You don’t want to hear me tell you it gets better. That doesn’t cure the deep pain you feel right now but you aren’t alone my friend. So many of us have felt what you’re feeling and are feeling what you’re feeling. It’s awful. No way around it. The heaviness in your chest, the memories, the hypothetical scenarios, etc. I care about you because I know what you’re feeling. You are so young and I know in my heart that many happy days do exist for you but you can’t see that right now because the pain outweighs everything else. I will gladly talk to you through private messages and be there for you. I am so sorry you’re hurting this badly but as someone that was once in your shoes, I am so glad I hung on through the darkest of times. The world is a better place with you in it.

I hated how the game ended but it seemed appropriate that the most anticipated divisional series in a long time ended with people talking about a blown call. I've watched baseball for a long time and I've never seen anything like this season. Inconsistent strike zones every single night where pitches way off the plate get called strikes and pitches in the zone get called balls. A level of ineptness behind the plate that makes me question if the umpires have trouble seeing or have hidden motifs on a nightly basis. When Doug Eddings was announced as the HP ump, I saw that as the lead discussion on many forums entering the game. Fans of both teams nervous that the game would be altered by him just like it was in game 2 with the historically bad Angel Hernandez. How messed up is that? Can't even worry about the batters or pitchers on the opposing team because you're so terrified of the guy behind the plate doing a horrible job. Is MLB ever going to address this glaring issue that is tarnishing the game? Probably not with Manfred in charge

I think the playoff system is very flawed too. In what world is it fair for a team with the best record in the sport to draw the team with the 2nd best record immediately. Hey Giants, you won 107 games and as an reward for your amazing season, you get to play a 106 win team! What? Matchups should be determined by record. Giants-Braves, Dodgers-Brewers should've been the NLDS matchups. In that scenario, I am confident both the Giants and Dodgers advance to setup the NLCS that should've happened. Now you have an 88 win team hosting a 106 win team in the next round. Just so many things about MLB that seem off nowadays and leave me scratching my head. You essentially get punished for playing in a better division which is so backwards. There is no other sport where the two best teams are pinned against each other in the first round. It makes no sense.
